symptom: An early logo click from a public world page to the homepage waits roughly 2.8 seconds, while the same route after warmup completes in roughly 0.2 seconds.
expected_behavior: Eligible public navigation should begin destination preparation immediately after hydration and reach meaningful content with minimal post-click delay.
environment: Production https://vii.spaplus.co on 2026-10-15 plus source branch review/vii-api-refresh-20261008.

steps: Click the header logo shortly after the page is ready and time arrival of the homepage heading.
Return to /hourly, wait for warmup, repeat the click.
reproduction.evidence: Early transition 2772ms; warmed transition 205ms. Repeated direct public responses had no X-VII-Page-Cache and returned Cache-Control: no-store, must-revalidate.

observations.observation: SmartNavigationWarmup waits for requestIdleCallback with a 1200ms timeout or a 500ms timer.
Homepage review details start only after four catalog summary calls finish.
Source contains an R2 anonymous document cache, but current production public responses show no cache markers.

hypotheses.mechanism: Delayed idle scheduling causes an ordinary early click to beat the homepage prefetch.
hypotheses.prediction: A warmed transition is fast while an early transition waits for the server response.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Compare identical clicks before and after allowing warmup to complete.

hypotheses.mechanism: The click handler or client router itself blocks navigation for seconds.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Time the click after the destination is prefetched.

hypotheses.mechanism: An avoidable serial homepage detail phase lengthens cold origin response time.
hypotheses.prediction: Rated-place details begin only after all summary reads resolve.
hypotheses.result: homeRatedPlaces is awaited only after the four-way Promise.all.

hypotheses.mechanism: The currently deployed anonymous page-cache path is missing or ineffective.
hypotheses.prediction: Repeated eligible production responses lack VII HIT markers and remain no-store.
hypotheses.discriminating_test: Probe public routes twice and inspect headers.
hypotheses.result: All sampled public routes lacked X-VII-Page-Cache and returned no-store.

fix.change: Pending: immediate eligible warmup, concurrent homepage data dependencies and a longer bounded anonymous homepage TTL with preserved exclusions.

remaining_unknowns: Whether the currently authorized production Site target can be accessed for deployment and live cache verification.
authorization_boundary: Performance repair and publication to the existing VII Site only; no alternate project or private caching.
